name: Keytop Parking Inc.
summary: Keytop Parking Inc. designs and develops smart parking space management platform. The company's platform integrates smart parking systems, smart parking management services, and parking facilities and platform operations. The company offers AI-based ANPR ticketless parking management systems, video and ultrasonic parking guidance systems, automatic turnstiles, and EV charging stations. It provides services including fully integrated, end-to-end parking platforms with cloud-based management, automated billing, and real-time analytics.
